<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <title>Birthdate Field</title>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
</head>
<body>
  <form action="#" method="post">
    <label for="birthdate">Birthdate</label>
    <input
      type="date"
      id="birthdate"
      name="birthdate"
      required
      autocomplete="bday"
      aria-describedby="birthdate-help"
    >
    <small id="birthdate-help">Enter your date of birth.</small>
  </form>
</body>
</html>

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />

</head>

  <main>
    <h1>Sign up</h1>

    <form id="signup" novalidate>
      <div>
        <label for="birthdate">Birthdate</label>
        <div id="birthdate-hint" class="hint">Enter your date of birth. Use the calendar picker or type YYYY-MM-DD. You must be at least 13 years old.</div>
        <input
          id="birthdate"
          name="birthdate"
          type="date"
          required
          aria-describedby="birthdate-hint birthdate-error"
          aria-invalid="false"
          autocomplete="bday"
        />
        <p id="birthdate-error" class="error" role="alert" aria-live="polite"></p>
      </div>

      <button type="submit">Continue</button>
    </form>
  </main>
